description: Full vacancies that employers posted on CyprusJobs.eu themselves (not copied from other sites), newest first, with description, pay, town and the link to apply; page through with offset. For job agents, aggregators and HR services that keep their own copy fresh. Needs an API key (free during our launch): https://cyprusjobs.eu/developers.

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian); default en

offset.description: How many vacancies to skip, for the next page (default 0)

since.description: Only vacancies posted on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

name: vacancy_feed
title: Feed of vacancies posted by employers
